details: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh recently indicated that interest rates might need to rise further due to persistent inflation, challenging market expectations for easier monetary policy. His hawkish remarks at the Jackson Hole symposium on August 28, reiterated on August 30, suggested that financial conditions could still be too loose. This stance led to a repricing of future rate increase probabilities, triggering a significant sell-off across risk assets, including cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.
title: Fed Chair Warsh's Hawkish Stance Fuels Rate Hike Expectations, Impacts Crypto

details: The latest U.S. Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) inflation report, released on August 26, revealed that price pressures were higher than anticipated. This unexpected rise in inflation data reinforced concerns about sustained price growth, suggesting that the Federal Reserve may have less flexibility for a dovish shift in monetary policy. The report contributed to a cautious, bearish sentiment in the broader financial markets, extending to the cryptocurrency sector.
title: US PCE Inflation Hotter Than Expected, Dampens Crypto Market Sentiment
